# TokenSaver CLI — llms.txt
# https://github.com/tokensaver-ai/tokensaver-cli
# Product: https://tokensaver.fr · Console: https://platform.tokensaver.fr

> Open-source CLI (`tokensaver-cli`, command `tokensaver`) that routes AI coding agents
> (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) through the TokenSaver governed control plane.
> MIT license. Python ≥ 3.10. Stdlib only — no runtime dependencies.

## Install & 60-second start

pip install -U tokensaver-cli
tokensaver login
tokensaver route claude --launch
tokensaver doctor --claude
tokensaver flows --open

## What TokenSaver is

- AI trust / governance platform (SaaS): cache, RAG, compression, PII, quotas, audit, Flux IA observability
- **600+ models** in Agent Registry (Pro/BYOK); **Free plan = 15 hosted models** (GLM, DeepSeek, Llama, …)
- Zero Trust Agent Registry for LLM models
- MCP tools server: https://mcp.tokensaver.fr/mcp
- MCP Trust Gateway (filesystem): https://gateway.tokensaver.fr/mcp
- API: https://api.tokensaver.fr (OpenAI + Anthropic compatible)
- Console (control plane): https://platform.tokensaver.fr
- Sign up: https://platform.tokensaver.fr/en/signup
- Log in: https://platform.tokensaver.fr/en/login
- Flux IA (live runs): …/en/{workspaceId}/dashboard?tab=flows — CLI: tokensaver flows --open
- Agentic graph (multi-agent audit): …/en/{workspaceId}/execution-graph?period=7d

## CLI commands (high level)

- Auth: login, logout, whoami, keys list|create|revoke
- Route: route claude|cursor|codex|proxy|mcp [--launch]; unroute <target>
- Models: models, use, profiles, approve, catalog
- Observability: flows [--open], status
- Health: doctor [--claude] [--local]

## Claude Code plugin

After `tokensaver route claude`, skill `tokensaver-router` provides slash commands:
/tokensaver-router:models, :use, :flows, :quota, :cache, :doctor, :login, etc.

## Credentials

- File: ~/.config/tokensaver/credentials.json (mode 0600)
- Env override: TOKENSAVER_API_KEY=ts_…
- Self-host: TOKENSAVER_MODE=local or --local on commands

## OSS vs platform

- This repo (tokensaver-ai/tokensaver-cli): public mirror of packages/cli — MIT
- Platform backend/console: proprietary SaaS; CLI is the free on-ramp
- Do not confuse with unrelated PyPI package name `tokensaver` (different project)
